item.title: 2025 was the year we all tried not to die
item.description: Longevity was the biggest buzzword in health and fitness, with everyone from your Hyrox fanatic neighbour to, er, President Putin talking about it. What does our sudden obsession with not dying tell us about the way we’re living?

item.title: Diary of an undercover watch geek
item.description: Watch communities have long had a bad rep for being closed off and stuffy, not to mention judgy. To find out whether that’s still the case, we sent an aspiring watch guy with next-to-no horological knowledge to one of London’s newest watch meet-ups

item.title: 2025 was the year the manosphere went mainstream
item.description: From Trump 2.0 to anti-immigration protests to the biggest hit show on Netflix, this was the year anti-feminist subcultures seeped from the internet into everyday life. James Bloodworth, a reporter who has been to the front line of the manosphere, reflects on where it might all be heading
